title: Electronics Return & Refund Policy (2023 Legacy Edition)
content:
POLICY POL-001-v1: Electronics Return & Refund Policy (2023 Edition)
Status: SUPERSEDED as of 2023-12-31 by POL-001-v2.
Scope: All consumer electronics sold on the marketplace prior to 2024.
Key Terms:
1. Customers may return opened or used electronic items within 30 days of delivery for a full 100% refund to the original payment method.
2. No restocking fee is charged for opened electronics during this 30-day window.
3. Return shipping is fully subsidized by the platform.

title: Electronics Replacement & Return Policy (2024 Revised)
content:
POLICY POL-001-v2: Electronics Replacement & Return Policy (2024 Revised)
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-01-01. Supersedes POL-001-v1.
Scope: All consumer electronics purchased on or after January 1, 2024.
Key Terms:
1. Opened electronics are eligible for replacement only within 7 days of delivery if verified defective.
2. Cash refunds are strictly limited to unopened, sealed items returned within 14 days of delivery.
3. Software, digital codes, and activated devices are strictly non-refundable.
4. The 30-day return window from the 2023 policy is completely abolished.

title: Apparel and Footwear Standard Return SOP
content:
POLICY POL-002: Apparel and Footwear Standard Return SOP
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-01-15.
Scope: Clothing, footwear, and fashion accessories.
Key Terms:
1. Apparel items and shoes are eligible for return or size exchange within 15 days of delivery.
2. All original tags, barcodes, and packaging must be intact and unwashed.
3. If original tags are intact, customer is entitled to a 100% full refund or free size exchange.
4. If tags are detached or missing, returns will be rejected or subject to a 50% restocking penalty.

title: Platform Protection Policy for In-Transit Damage
content:
POLICY POL-003-PLATFORM: Platform Protection Policy for In-Transit Damage
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-02-01.
Scope: All orders damaged during shipping and delivery.
Key Terms:
1. If an item arrives damaged and the customer reports it within 48 hours of delivery with photographic evidence, the platform grants a 100% immediate refund.
2. The seller cannot deduct any restocking or return shipping fees under any circumstances.
3. Platform protection supersedes individual seller policies and guidelines.

title: Marketplace Seller Policy on In-Transit Damage Claims
content:
POLICY POL-003-SELLER: Marketplace Seller Policy on In-Transit Damage Claims
Status: CONFLICTING SELLER GUIDELINE published 2024-02-15.
Scope: Seller merchant guidelines.
Key Terms:
1. Sellers are entitled to inspect returned damaged goods before refund disbursement.
2. Sellers reserve the right to deduct a 20% restocking fee on damaged claims if the packaging is opened, regardless of when reported.
3. Note: In disputes, check platform authority hierarchy.

title: Grocery & Perishable Goods Return Guidelines
content:
POLICY POL-004: Grocery & Perishable Goods Return Guidelines
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-01-01.
Scope: Fresh fruits, vegetables, dairy, meat, and packaged groceries.
Key Terms:
1. Fresh fruits, vegetables, dairy, and frozen foods are strictly non-returnable.
2. If products are received spoiled, expired, or rotten, customer must submit photo proof within 6 hours of delivery to claim a direct wallet credit.
3. Requests submitted after 6 hours from delivery are permanently ineligible for refund.

title: Luxury Watches & Timepieces Return Protocol (DRAFT)
content:
POLICY POL-005: Luxury Watches & Timepieces Return Protocol (DRAFT)
Status: INCOMPLETE DRAFT published 2024-03-01.
Scope: Luxury watches exceeding INR 25,000.
Key Terms:
1. High-value timepieces above INR 25,000 must undergo physical serial number authentication at the central fulfillment hub.
2. Missing Field: The exact return window in days is [PENDING LEGAL APPROVAL] and not yet defined.
3. Missing Field: Refund processing SLA and inspection turnaround days are [UNSPECIFIED].
4. Agents must NOT invent or assume return windows or SLA days for luxury watches until this policy is ratified.

title: Zero Tolerance Counterfeit Protection Policy
content:
POLICY POL-006: Zero Tolerance Counterfeit Protection Policy
Status: ACTIVE.
Scope: All categories.
Key Terms:
1. If an item is proven counterfeit with manufacturer or authorized center certification, the customer receives an immediate 100% refund plus a 25% goodwill voucher.
2. The associated seller account will be placed on immediate suspension pending legal audit.
3. No return shipping is required from the customer for counterfeit goods.

title: Delivery Delay Compensation SLA
content:
POLICY POL-007: Delivery Delay Compensation SLA
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-01-10.
Scope: In-transit orders experiencing logistics delays.
Key Terms:
1. If an order delivery exceeds the promised delivery date by more than 5 calendar days, the customer is eligible for a guaranteed INR 150 delay credit.
2. If an order is delayed more than 10 calendar days past promise date, customer may cancel with a 100% full refund.
3. Claims must be submitted within 14 days of final delivery.

title: Cosmetics, Fragrances, and Personal Care Return Policy
content:
POLICY POL-008: Cosmetics, Fragrances, and Personal Care Return Policy
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-01-01.
Scope: Skincare, perfumes, makeup, and personal hygiene products.
Key Terms:
1. Due to mandatory health and sanitation regulations, beauty products and skincare items cannot be returned or refunded once the tamper-evident seal is broken or opened.
2. Unopened items with intact factory seal may be returned within 10 days of delivery.
3. Spilled or broken bottles damaged in transit are covered by POL-003-PLATFORM if reported within 48 hours.

title: High-Value Transaction Refund Escalation Protocol
content:
POLICY POL-009: High-Value Transaction Refund Escalation Protocol
Status: ACTIVE as of 2024-02-01.
Scope: High-value refund transactions across all categories.
Key Terms:
1. Any refund request where order_amount exceeds INR 50,000 requires Tier-2 Escalation and written sign-off from the Operations Manager prior to triggering bank refund dispatch.
2. Standard automated refund bots and level-1 customer support agents are prohibited from issuing refunds > INR 50,000 directly.
